mysidibou

unesco project

protect a place. build its future.

mysidibou is my project for sidi bou saïd, tunisia. the ambition: a cleaner village and a long-term approach to protecting its hillside setting for the generations that follow.

the plan connects daily litter collection and less plastic with architecture, art and local participation. an art café and art sales are intended to help fund the work.

focus: heritage · public space · community

kefir

probiotics · energy · immunity · gut health

a small culture. a daily ritual.

living kefir grains and a simple guide to making milk kefir at home. the grains are a reusable culture: after fermentation, they are separated from the drink and used for the next batch.

the idea is to make home fermentation approachable, with guidance on the daily routine and caring for the culture. get in touch for current availability.

includes: living grains · getting-started guide

souralf

your living sourdough

flour. water. time.

an active sourdough starter for baking bread at home. a starter is a culture maintained with flour and water, used to ferment dough and kept for future bakes.

feeding instructions and a first-loaf guide give you a starting point for building your own baking routine. get in touch for current availability.

includes: starter · feeding instructions · first-loaf guide

wim hof instructor

breath · cold · resilience · performance

breath. cold. presence.

private one-to-one coaching with a certified wim hof instructor. my work brings together breath, cold and mindset, with attention to the person behind the practice.

start with a conversation about your experience and what you are looking for. we can discuss the format, location and whether coaching is a suitable next step for you.

format: personal coaching · by enquiry

neuroarchitecture

phd in progress

design for the person inside the space.

my phd in progress explores the relationship between architecture and human experience. the question: how can the spaces we inhabit be designed with the people using them in mind?

light, spatial proportions and materials are central themes in this enquiry. it connects my background in architecture with an interest in perception, behaviour and wellbeing.

focus: architecture · perception · human experience
